reading.body:
Gamma is an AI-powered design tool focused on generating presentations without requiring design or coding skills, with revenue from tiered pricing where paid plans unlock newer models and additional AI credits.

The company's business model depends on AI model access as a differentiator. Free users get basic AI credits while paid tiers unlock "newer AI models," implying Gamma either licenses models from providers or fine-tunes versions itself, making model availability and cost a direct constraint on its product offering. This ties the company's growth to underlying compute capacity. The monetization of model access rather than just compute credits suggests Gamma is positioned downstream of model providers, competing partly on which frontier capabilities it can offer clients fastest.

The default inclusion of free-tier content in AI training, with opt-out available, creates a data acquisition mechanism. This is typical for companies bootstrapping model improvement with user-generated content. It does not indicate the scale at which this training happens or whether Gamma trains its own models or feeds data to partners.

The data does not cover Gamma's infrastructure costs, hosting arrangements, or whether it runs its own endpoints or relies on API access. It also does not specify which models power its offerings or how many users generate content at each tier. Without usage figures, it is unclear whether Gamma's constraint is compute availability, model licensing cost, or customer acquisition.

profile_text.body:
Gamma is an AI design tool offered through gamma.app. The company describes it as an all-in-one AI-powered design partner for creating presentations, websites, and other visual content, and says no code or design experience is needed. Its product, also named Gamma, is a presentation generation tool.

According to the site, Gamma has a free tier that includes a starter pack of AI credits for generating presentations, webpages, documents, and social media assets, and users can earn more credits by referring friends. Paid plans are said to unlock the latest AI models, additional credits, advanced analytics, custom fonts, and the option to remove the Gamma badge. The site states that most people start free and upgrade once Gamma becomes part of how they work.

On data handling, the site says content in Team and Business workspaces is automatically excluded from AI training with no extra action required. For individual workspaces on the Free, Plus, Pro, or Ultra plans, content is allowed to be used to train AI features by default, and the site says users can opt out at any time through their account settings.
